findings.description: The separator condition was inverted when moving the join into get_help_spec. The original chose "; " when any_prefix_is_slash was true and " / " otherwise. The new code uses "; " when the flag is false and " / " when it is true, so the help spelling separators are swapped for every option.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option rendered in help, such as a plain `--verbose`/`-v` option (flag false) or a slash-prefixed `--shout/--no-shout` option (flag true). Mechanism: the ternary branches are swapped relative to the original line. Impact: `--help` output shows `-v; --verbose` instead of `-v / --verbose` for ordinary options, and slash options get the wrong separator, which changes user-visible help text.
